returnTime.title: Return window
returnTime.description: How long after delivery a shopper may return an item (in Return window unit), unless the item or its condition grade has its own window. 0 = no returns.

returnTimeUnit.title: Return window unit
returnTimeUnit.description: Days, months or years (at most 10 years); shown as typed: 1 year stays 1 year.

warrantyTime.title: Warranty
warrantyTime.description: How long after delivery a shopper may make a warranty claim (in Warranty unit), unless the item or its condition grade has its own. 0 = no warranty.

warrantyTimeUnit.title: Warranty unit
warrantyTimeUnit.description: Days, months or years (at most 10 years); shown as typed: 1 year stays 1 year.

returnMethod.title: How items come back
returnMethod.description: How shoppers return an item, as your return policy tells search engines: by mail, at your shop, or either.

returnShippingFee.title: Return shipping
returnShippingFee.description: Who pays to send a returned item back, as your return policy tells search engines: the shopper, nobody (free returns), or a fixed fee you charge (Return shipping fee).

returnShippingFeeAmount.title: Return shipping fee
returnShippingFeeAmount.description: With Return shipping at a fixed fee: the fee, in minor units of your currency (0 = free returns).

maxPhotos.title: Photos per claim
maxPhotos.description: How many photos a shopper may add to a claim (0 = none).

reasons.title: Reasons
reasons.description: The reasons shoppers pick from when they make a claim. Empty = they say why in their own words. Which claims they may make, and their statuses, are the Claim kinds and Claim statuses lists.

otherReason.title: Offer "Other" with the reasons
otherReason.description: With reasons listed: shoppers may also pick Other and say why in their own words.

pointsBack.title: Points taken back
pointsBack.description: Proportional: in proportion to what is refunded. Full refund only: only when the whole order is refunded.
